Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the first input image, one isolated transparent game sprite, Moon Shadow Assassin Girl east-facing normal-attack frame 05. The second image is the primary approved painting/material/style reference only, never add its UI or background.
Make one small anatomical correction: redraw ONLY the boot below the ankle of the rear extended leg at SCREEN LEFT. It currently points its toe backward toward screen-left. The rear heel is at the far-left/back end of that boot; the rounded moon-decorated toe projects to the RIGHT of its ankle. Connect shin, ankle and foot naturally, not a twisted ankle. Both feet must point into the eastward action, not form opposite outward V toes. Preserve navy boot leather, warm gold sole edge and bands, moon decoration and original lighting.
Strict invariants: keep the front SCREEN RIGHT leg and foot completely unchanged; keep head, face, hair, expression, violet eye, costume, scarf, upper body, both hands, both weapons, arm positions and exact attack phase unchanged. Exactly two hands holding exactly two crescent daggers, one in each hand. Do not add a near-side hair flower. Preserve original camera, whole-canvas subject placement, scale and margins exactly, with no recentering, zooming, cropping or reframing. Match clean detailed soft hand-painted chibi finish. Full square transparent RGBA canvas at native high resolution, no floor, no shadow, no labels or UI, no text. Output a single complete frame, not a sheet.

scope: only rear screen-left boot below ankle; original final retained pending review
